instruction: Candidate software launch paths: Revit 2025: C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Revit 2025\Revit.exe; Archicad 27: C:\Program Files\Graphisoft\Archicad 27\Archicad Starter.exe; Abaqus 2025: C:\SIMULIA\EstProducts\2025\win_b64\resources\install\cmdDirFeature\launcher.bat. On this machine, open Revit 2025, Archicad 27, or Abaqus CAE from the corresponding desktop shortcut, according to the tool you choose for the task. Revit 2025, Archicad 27, and Abaqus 2025 are available at the paths listed above. Choose an appropriate tool from these three to complete the task. Small roofed studio. Start from a blank BIM project. Model one small studio room with four walls, one floor slab, one simple roof over the footprint, one entry door, and two exterior windows. This task focuses on adding a roof after creating a simple room shell. Create real BIM model elements rather than visual-only detail geometry. Use the selected application's Room/Zone/Space tool for named rooms so they export as IFC spaces. Save the completed model deliverable into `C:\Users\user\Desktop\result` using the selected application's built-in export. Use IFC4 if the export dialog asks for a setup, and enable room or space export if that option is available. The exported IFC should contain IfcSpace rooms named Studio; at least 1 building storeys, at least 4 wall elements, at least 1 slabs, at least 1 roofs, at least 1 doors, at least 2 windows. Other dimensions, exact coordinates, materials, family type names, wall thicknesses, and harmless metadata may vary.
